selection_rule: Round1 update796 chosen using internal validation before unsealing; no selection or tuning on final results.
input_policy: Complete unchanged schema+question template. 4096 is a predeclared resource guard, not truncation. It replaces the internal-validation 1024 guard for both final arms before any final results.
budget_policy: More examples: 100-minute generation-loop guard and 105-minute worker hard limit per arm. Same per-question 30 seconds, one greedy sequence, max256 new tokens, no retries.
metric_policy: Unchanged original SQLite EX, not official test-suite accuracy. Prediction SQL errors count; infrastructure or gold failures stop. Final official-dev data never used to train or retune.
sampler_policy: One persistent nvidia-smi process at 500ms; first sample/freshness deadline5s; no restart/retry; shared2s cleanup; new independent freeze before generation.
continuation_policy: Preserve original616 prediction bytes, generate only indices616..1033 once. No best-of selection; independent prompts have no inter-question KV reuse. R1 generates1034 once.
